descriptions.zh: 查询结果包含了轻量应用服务器中国站与国际站的全部可用地域。
descriptions.en: The query results include all the Alibaba Cloud regions where Simple Application Server is supported on the international site (alibabacloud.com) and the China site (aliyun.com).
